clue.text: Permutation tallies-wire shows they should come up on the pools

definitions.text: they should come up on the pools

indicators.note: a permutation is a reordering, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A betting permutation on the football pools, with tallies sent by wire, will show what comes up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pools' suggests the football pools, a British weekly betting coupon, and 'Permutation' a pools bet; really the pools are ponds, and 'Permutation' rearranges TALLIESWIRE.
explanation.definitionFit: These aquatic plants float up to flower on the surface of ponds.

clue.text: A boxing-match close by

parts.note: a bout is a single contest in the ring

explanation.surface: A boxing match is about to finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Being around or near somewhere is to be near at hand, nearby.

clue.text: Recluse before time, it turns out

parts.note: ere is a poetic word meaning before

indicators.note: turns out signals the letters of the word time being turned into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A hermit, it emerges, was there before his time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns out' rearranges TIME into MITE; 'it' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit living apart for religious reasons is a classic solitary.

clue.text: £51, convertible!

parts.note: LI is 51 in Roman numerals
a quid is British slang for one pound sterling

explanation.surface: Fifty-one pounds, and it can be exchanged!
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in reverse order to the clue: the number first, then the pound sign as QUID.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid assets are those readily turned into cash.

clue.text: One's role, possibly, as agent for easing muscle-tension

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters may be arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether their job might be that of a masseur relaxing stiff muscles.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that relaxes or slackens tight muscles works as a relaxant.

clue.text: Rabble-rousing does not begin with this issue

indicators.note: does not begin means the word's opening letter is dropped

parts.note: sedition is incitement of the public against authority

explanation.surface: Inflammatory writing is absent from the start of this number of the paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with this' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A particular printing or number of a publication is one issue of it.

clue.text: Cover for the present?

parts.note: reads like a temporary stand-in for now, but the present is a gift and its cover is the decorative sheet round it

explanation.surface: Looking for a temporary stand-in at the moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative sheets enclose gifts, so they cover a gift.

clue.text: People who find fault with door-fittings

definitions.meaning: critics who constantly disparage are said to knock things
metal hinged pieces on a front door for rapping to announce a visitor

explanation.definitionFit: Critics who run things down, and the hinged rappers fixed on front doors.

clue.text: Continental style of care for the body

definitions.text: Continental style of care for the body

parts.words: Continental style of care for the body
parts.note: suggests a European fitness regime, but read literally in French the phrase means spirit of the body, the loyalty of a group

explanation.surface: A European approach to looking after one's physique.
explanation.definitionFit: A French phrase for group morale, literally the spirit of the body, the corps being a group.

clue.text: Flower for right-handed individual

parts.note: RH is the abbreviation for right hand
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: A bloom picked for someone who uses their right hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is a crossword trick: something that flows, here a river; the RHONE is a major French river.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is something that flows, and this is a great river of France and Switzerland.

clue.text: Inquest to sort out results of division

indicators.note: sort out signals that the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A coroner's hearing is asked to make sense of how a split ended.
explanation.definitionFit: Dividing one number by another gives a result, and the results are these.

clue.text: Pop is polished off in it!

definitions.text: Pop is polished off in it!

parts.words: Pop is polished off in it!
parts.note: sounds like a fizzy drink being drunk up, but Pop is father and polished off means killed

explanation.surface: A fizzy drink gets finished in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The crime of killing one's own father, since Pop is a familiar name for a dad.

clue.text: Encounter some bargain curiosities

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Come across a few curios going cheap.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet with or bring on oneself something unwelcome, such as debts or a penalty.

clue.text: Part of foot dancing in unison with others, say

definitions.meaning: the arched middle top section of the foot

definitions.text: dancing in unison with others, say
definitions.meaning: dancers moving together are keeping pace, as a two-word phrase

explanation.definitionFit: The arch of the foot, and a phrase meaning in time with others, as dancers or marchers are.

clue.text: Judicious, as in a Jane Austen novel?

definitions.text: as in a Jane Austen novel?
definitions.meaning: Austen wrote Sense and Sensibility, and the word asked for looks as if built from those two title words

explanation.definitionFit: Prudent and level-headed, with a playful nod to Austen's title Sense and Sensibility.

clue.text: To check air-intake, go back to the drawing-board

parts.note: to rein is to check or restrain, as with a horse
a vent is an opening that lets air in

explanation.surface: An engineer told to stop an air inlet must start the design again.
explanation.definitionFit: Starting a design over means creating it afresh from scratch.

clue.text: Stock record in Newmarket?

parts.note: sounds like a market's share register, but Newmarket is the home of British horse racing and the stock is bloodstock

explanation.surface: A register of shares kept at a new market.
explanation.walkthrough: Newmarket is an English town that is the centre of British racehorse breeding and training.
explanation.definitionFit: The official register of thoroughbred pedigrees, the stock being bloodstock.

clue.text: Vessels of diplomats using military threats?

definitions.text: Vessels of diplomats using military threats?

parts.words: Vessels of diplomats using military threats?
parts.note: alludes to the phrase for diplomacy backed by naval force, whose vessels are small armed warships

explanation.surface: Ships belonging to envoys who rely on threatening force.
explanation.definitionFit: Small armed naval vessels, which give their name to forceful diplomacy.

clue.text: Ploy I am devising should be plain in Greece

indicators.note: devising signals that these letters are being worked into something new

explanation.surface: A tactic I'm planning ought to be obvious in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: The site of the ancient games lies on a plain in Elis, in the Peloponnese.

clue.text: Immaculate tea-set put out

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea

indicators.note: put out signals the letters of the word set being disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A spotless set of teacups has been laid out.
explanation.definitionFit: Pure and unsullied, especially morally spotless.

clue.text: Square dance call to gardeners at end of day?

definitions.text: call to gardeners at end of day?
definitions.meaning: a playful order to gardeners to lay their tools aside, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: A lively country dance, and humorously an order to put the garden tool down.

clue.text: Confidential remarks concerning first teams?

definitions.meaning: words spoken so only some hear, as by an actor to the audience
first-choice teams are A teams, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Remarks muttered privately, and whimsically the top-ranked teams.

clue.text: Cordiality of little woman, full of sex appeal

indicators.note: full of means the name contains the other piece

parts.note: Amy March is one of the sisters in Little Women
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A small lady's friendliness is packed with allure.
explanation.definitionFit: Friendship and goodwill between people or nations.

clue.text: Reckless road-speed is criminal

indicators.note: reckless suggests letters thrown about wildly into a new order

explanation.surface: Dangerous speeding on the road is an offence.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperate, lawless outlaw.

clue.text: First cervical vertebra of a Titan?

definitions.meaning: the topmost bone of the spine, which holds up the skull
in Greek myth the Titan who holds up the heavens

explanation.definitionFit: The bone supporting the head, named after the mythic giant who bore the sky.

clue.text: Solid figure from the Oval, we hear

definitions.text: Solid figure from the Oval, we hear

parts.words: Solid figure from the Oval, we hear
parts.note: the Oval suggests the London cricket ground, but an oval is an ellipse, and the solid made from one is named as if ellipse-like

explanation.surface: A dependable player from the Oval cricket ground, people say.
explanation.walkthrough: The Oval is a cricket ground in London; 'Solid figure' could be a reliable player there.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-dimensional shape whose plane sections are ellipses, made by rotating an oval.

clue.text: Alternative to cut deck?

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
to lop is to cut off

explanation.surface: Should one cut the pack of cards another way?
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest deck of a sailing ship.

clue.text: Maudlin state when Ma's kiss is sloppy?

indicators.note: sloppy suggests something messy, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A mother's sloppy kiss is sentimental.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive sentimentality, gushing feeling.
